partner_result_applied.application: Applied to the exact physical-coordinate Schur decomposition to obtain the recurrence T(B)=2 sqrt(B/c0).

new_claims: Signed Schur spectral-count theorem: N_+(S;alpha ell)>=N_+(A;ell)-1_{a>0} and N_-(S;alpha ell)>=N_-(A;ell)-1_{a<0}, alpha=4/(sqrt(q^2+4)+q)^2.

At a failed 1/39 spectral-window gate, every heavy row is either diagonal-heavy with alpha(q)|a|>=c0 ell, c0=0.0004730185203987298..., or cross-dominated with ||b||>gamma0 ell, gamma0=0.003925464331383298....

Along any sequence of diagonal-heavy Schur eliminations, normalized constants obey T^k(B)=Bstar^(1-2^-k) B^(2^-k)<=max(Bstar,B), Bstar=8456.328510410563..., so arbitrarily many additional large eigenvalues do not create recursive constant blow-up on that branch.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-CROSS-DOMINATED-HEAVY-ROW-CLOSURE-v2: pay ||b||>gamma0 ell using grouped-coordinate product smoothing plus the signed residual information, without reciprocal extraction of one tiny coefficient/minor.
